006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018
019import java.util.List;
020import java.util.stream.Stream;
021
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * /** Implements <a href=
026 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-distinct-values">fn:distinct-values</a>
027 * functions. This implementation does not implement the two-arg variant with
028 * collation at this time.
029 */
030public final class FnDistinctValues {
031  @NonNull
032  private static final String NAME = "distinct-values";
033  @NonNull
034  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_ONE_ARG = IFunction.builder()
035      .name(NAME)
036      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
037      .deterministic()
038      .contextDependent()
039      .focusIndependent()
040      .argument(IArgument.builder()
041          .name("arg")
042          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
043          .zeroOrMore()
044          .build())
045      .returnType(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
046      .returnZeroOrMore()
047      .functionHandler(FnDistinctValues::executeOneArg)
048      .build();
049
050  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
051  @NonNull
052  private static ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> executeOneArg(@NonNull IFunction function,
053      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
054      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
055      IItem focus) {
056    ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> seq = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
057
058    return ISequence.of(fnDistinctValues(seq, dynamicContext));
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Get the first occurrence of each distinct value in the provided list.
063   * <p>
064   * Based on the XPath 3.1 <a href=
065   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-distinct-values">fn:distinct-values</a>
066   * function.
067   *
068   * @param values
069   *          the items to get destinct values for
070   * @param dynamicContext
071   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
072   *          timezone
073   * @return a the list of distinct values
074   */
075  @NonNull
076  public static Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> fnDistinctValues(
077      @NonNull List<IAnyAtomicItem> values,
078      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
079    return ObjectUtils.notNull(values.stream()
080        .filter(ICollectionValue.distinctByDeepEquals(IAnyAtomicItem.class, dynamicContext)));
081  }
082
083  private FnDistinctValues() {
084    // disable construction
085  }
086}
